en.title: Crabs Steamed with Lemon and Onion (Kaburya)
en.intro: Recipe 361, page 156 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Wash the crabs under running water.
steps.n2: Put everything in a pot, without any water, over a low heat.
steps.n3: Toss from time to time; depending on their size the crabs should be done in 7–10 minutes.
steps.n4: Eat them just as they are: crack the shells of the body and legs and pick out the meat.

legacySteps: Wash the crabs under running water.
Put everything in a pot, without any water, over a low heat.
Toss from time to time; depending on their size the crabs should be done in 7–10 minutes.
Eat them just as they are: crack the shells of the body and legs and pick out the meat.
